utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Tuesday the tenth, let's get going. Can everyone hear me?

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, loud and clear. Anyone watch the football last night? Absolute shambles.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Knew you'd get that in before we'd even started.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And that's the sports report concluded, cheers.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While we're off topic, the charity bake sale on Friday looks good. Saw the pictures of what people are bringing.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: More reliable supply of cake than most of our parts, that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before that becomes a procurement presentation. Anything already finished?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah so, already swapped the filter on the turbine two yesterday. That's done.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, so that's off the outstanding list?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yep. Just reporting it, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Same from me: signed off the inspection on the heater box on one on Tuesday. That's already complete.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Yeah, I've got that showing as closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Lovely. Plant observations, Marcus?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I saw the pressure on the tower dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Nothing sustained.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Just an observation, then, not putting a new job against it?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. It recovered without us touching anything.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I saw the pressure on the gas turbine one dip for a few minutes, it came back on its own. Similar sort of thing, but separate observation.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—it's back at normal now?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, back on its own. No outstanding work from that.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, both observations only. Hannah?

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: The supplier still hasn't confirmed the delivery for the little water valve on two. That's still blocked, I'm afraid.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no confirmed delivery showing. Same position, not a fresh action.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And that's separate from the sensor calibration, isn't it?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: It is. The sensors on the existing valve can be recalibrated; that doesn't need the incoming valve.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, Mide, if you've got a spare minute, can you recalibrate the sensors on the little water valve on two by 11am?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll recalibrate those by 11am. Can fit that in.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Okay, so we're not saying the replacement's suddenly available?

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: No, definitely not. Just recalibrating what's fitted. Delivery's still unconfirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, Mide has the calibration. No change to the supplier blocker.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Um, I'll inspect the Boiler Safety Relief Valve for leaks on the 3rd. That one's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Grace Liu. Boiler Safety Relief Valve leak inspection, on the 3rd, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yep, that's the commitment from me.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Right, and that's separate from the heater box inspection you mentioned?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah. Heater box is finished. This is the leak inspection on the Boiler Safety Relief Valve.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the HV board by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, stores Jamie. That sign-off is top priority please, by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Understood. Top priority, I'll do the sign-off by 11am.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Just keeping the wording straight: the sign-off, not adding any electrical work to that.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Exactly, the lock-out tag-out sign-off only.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: All right. Anything else from stores?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll do a site visit at the warehouse with the contractor by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Jamie Brennan for the site visit at the warehouse with the contractor, by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: That's right, I've got that.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, is that connected to the delivery Hannah was talking about?

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: No, separate thing. The visit isn't a promise that the valve's turning up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: There's also downtime for the arm on two that needs scheduling with production this afternoon. Low priority. We haven't got anyone taking that yet.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yeah, I know the one. I can't commit to taking the scheduling on, though.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone able to pick that up? Scheduling the downtime, not doing work on the arm.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. I can commit to the calibration, but not that as well.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, no taker. Scheduling downtime for the arm on two with production this afternoon stays unowned, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Understood. So no downtime booking agreed here.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Oh, and before it gets read out again: we were going to replace the belt on the alarm box but that's been pushed to next month so ignore it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, not today's work. Deferred to next month.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Exactly. Just didn't want someone thinking we'd missed it this morning.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: And the valve delivery remains a blocker only. Nothing newly agreed against that from me.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, quick check of what people have actually taken. Any corrections?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: None from me. I'll inspect the Boiler Safety Relief Valve for leaks on the 3rd, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Olumide Adeyemi
utterances.text: And I'll recalibrate the sensors on the little water valve on two by 11am. That's mine.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: I've got the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the HV board, top priority, by 11am. And the site visit at the warehouse with the contractor by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. The arm on two downtime scheduling with production is still needed this afternoon, low priority, but nobody's taken it. Not recording it as allocated.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Fair enough. And no action on my football club, then. Probably beyond engineering anyway.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Well beyond. Cheers, everyone, that's us.
